assignment.source: Explicit current-turn assignment from /root, limited to debug-font-2.0/3d-split-entry and debug-font-2.0/3d-split-exit.
assignment.historical_reviewer_note: Reviewer fields inside dated sole-decoder metadata are historical and do not attribute this direct review.

prior_checkpoint_scope: The saved checkpoint classifies both assigned clips as unviewed. This receipt adds the current review without modifying or inheriting direct claims from that checkpoint.
identity_validation: Original MP4 and every retained source WebP were independently rehashed at binding and assembly; file lengths and hashes match the frozen manifest. Lossless VP8L headers indicate the expected 1600 x 720 dimensions. Full encoded file-byte equality was independently compared within each payload group. The recording freeze and manifest are also bound to the decoder root freeze.
method: Manual tools.view_image inspection with detail=original of one immutable full-resolution 1600 x 720 WebP per distinct payload within this clip; observations were saved only after successful display. Every repeated identity retains its own path, source index and original packet PTS/time_base, with a reviewer-attributed reference to a directly inspected frame. No crops, resized copies, collages, recaptures, new video decoding or inference from manifest labels alone.
conclusion: All 68 retained source identities are covered by 34 direct full-resolution inspections and 34 independently verified byte matches. No exposed private card faces were observed. Native Ready clips the public claim in its split pane, and both Ready and returned Standard leave the hand and lower controls outside the recorded viewport. Hidden hand state, scrolling and control reachability remain unverified.

findings.observation: No private card faces were observed in the split selector, opaque/blank opening frames, native Ready viewport, full-width closing/privacy covers, or returned Standard viewport.
findings.limits: This is a retained-frame and visible-viewport observation, not continuous privacy or offscreen hand-state qualification.

findings.observation: Native Ready in the split pane shows a full readable Show hand label, Star table · round 1 and Your turn, but the public claim line is cut off by the lower edge. The hand, card area and lower game actions are outside the recorded viewport.
findings.limits: Scroll availability and control reachability are not established; this is not a confirmed interaction defect.

findings.observation: Returned full-width Standard shows the public claim and the explanation Only a challenge reveals the cards. against the lower image edge, where lower glyph portions meet or cross the edge. Hand, concealment controls and lower game actions are outside the recorded viewport.
findings.limits: The hidden hand state, scrolling and reachability are unverified; absence from these pixels is not proof that the UI is unavailable.

findings.observation: In encoded frame order, split native Ready through 52 is followed by full-width Closing table... with an opaque privacy cover at 53–58, the opaque privacy cover at 59–61, and returned Standard at 62.
findings.limits: Frame 61 is byte-matched to direct frame 60. This sequence does not align the transition with user input or prove continuous concealment.

layout_observations: The Table style selector in the split pane has readable Standard table, 2D table, 3D table and Done labels.
Opening/native privacy messages fit in the split pane; Standard table wraps onto two lines.
Native Ready shows a full Show hand label but clips the public claim line; hand and lower actions are beyond the viewport.
Returned full-width Standard places the claim explanation against the bottom edge and does not show the hand or lower controls.

phase_timing_scope: Original packet PTS/time_base establishes media order only; phase boundaries do not establish UTC or action timing.
limits: This receipt covers only the retained source-frame identities of the named recording, using the frozen sole-decoder WebP derivatives.

Original packet PTS/DTS and time_base are retained as media ordering. No host UTC, device monotonic clock, input DOWN/UP, or test-action alignment is inferred. Receipt creation UTC describes metadata authoring only.
Complete retained-frame coverage does not establish continuous on-device privacy between encoded frames, before or after the clip, or in another run.
No private card face was observed in the displayed viewport. An offscreen hand panel or a Show hand label does not establish the hidden hand state.

Visible lower-edge clipping is recorded as a viewport observation; these frames do not establish whether scrolling, touch actions, focus navigation, TalkBack, accessibility semantics, minimum target size, or controls outside the viewport work.
No new captures, video decoding, builds, native execution, device qualification, physical-network tests, store signing, or product/shared-file changes were performed by this reviewer.
